sample_unit: questions (12 cases x 5 questions per LLM)

links.outcome: Likert-scored LLM treatment recommendations versus multidisciplinary tumor board decisions across three LLMs
links.effect: ChatGPT mean 4.50 ± 0.57 vs Gemini 3.77 ± 0.43 and Copilot 3.85 ± 0.52 (p < 0.001); performance differed substantially between candidate tools.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated superior performance with the highest mean score (4.50 ± 0.57) and a median score of 5, significantly outperforming Gemini (mean 3.77 ± 0.43, median 4) and Copilot (mean 3.85 ± 0.52, median 4) (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the quality, accuracy, and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) compared to multidisciplinary tumor board decisions on 12 mesothelioma cases.
